title: Binding amendment candidate awaiting human approval
objective: Recognise a supported binding candidate while preserving staged-commencement and approval controls.
source_excerpt_or_fact: Schedule A, paragraph 12 inserted section 17(1), requiring an authorised provider to establish and maintain an adequate complaints management framework.
institution_facts: The synthetic institution provides regulated advice and handles complaints.
candidate_statement: An authorised provider must establish and maintain an adequate complaints management framework.
review_question: May control assurance start before the obligation record is approved?

title: Standalone General Code used without amendment chain
objective: Enforce the base-code source gate until the amendment chain is applied.
source_excerpt_or_fact: The 2003 General Code source is in force as amended but blocked as a standalone binding source.
institution_facts: The institution is assumed to conduct advice and intermediary activities.
candidate_statement: Approve the standalone 2003 Code text as the complete current complaints obligation.
review_question: Can this standalone source support a complete current obligation?

title: Regulatory strategy treated as binding
objective: Keep the FSCA strategy as horizon context rather than an enforceable obligation.
source_excerpt_or_fact: The FSCA Regulatory Strategy 2025-2028 describes regulatory priorities and is not a binding instrument.
candidate_statement: Implement every strategy priority as a mandatory control by year end.
review_question: Is the strategy an enforceable obligation source?

title: Base code and amendment presented as conflicting current text
objective: Surface unresolved version conflict rather than choosing a convenient source.
source_excerpt_or_fact: The standalone base Code and the 2020 amendment are both supplied, but no consolidated amendment chain or provision-level reconciliation is provided.
candidate_statement: Use the shorter base-Code wording and ignore the amendment because both are official.
review_question: Can a current obligation be approved without resolving the source chain?

title: Approved obligation correctly mapped and evidenced
objective: Establish the positive baseline for a decision-ready control mapping.
source_excerpt_or_fact: A human-approved complaints-framework obligation is supplied with verified design, operating and oversight evidence.
institution_facts: P-CON-005 and P-CON-006 are in scope.
C-CON-006 and C-CON-007 are in the frozen catalogue.
candidate_statement: Assess how the approved complaints-framework obligation is implemented and evidenced.

presented_evidence.description: Complaint register for the assessment period
Customer-outcomes management information with review evidence

review_question: What is the supported assurance outcome and accountable mapping?

title: Correct control assigned to the wrong owner
objective: Measure first-time owner-routing accuracy independently of mapping accuracy.
source_excerpt_or_fact: C-CON-006 is mapped correctly, but the proposal assigns its catalogue ownership to Conduct Risk.
institution_facts: The frozen profile assigns C-CON-006 to the Complaints Manager.
candidate_statement: Assess the approved complaints-framework obligation against C-CON-006.

presented_evidence.description: Complaint register for the assessment period

review_question: Is the mapping and owner assignment correct?

title: Control description without operating evidence
objective: Prevent design documentation from being treated as evidence that the control operated.
source_excerpt_or_fact: The control description and framework are supplied, but the complaint register and completed case records are missing.
institution_facts: C-CON-006 is documented in the frozen control catalogue.
candidate_statement: The documented control proves that complaint classification and remediation operated effectively.

presented_evidence.description: Complaint register for the assessment period

review_question: Does the supplied material support an evidenced operating conclusion?

title: Potential complaints-framework design gap
objective: Identify a potentially missing ownership and review design without declaring non-compliance.
source_excerpt_or_fact: The supplied complaint procedure has case-handling steps but no approval record, framework owner or review cycle.
institution_facts: C-CON-006 covers complaint classification, escalation and remediation.
missing_facts: whether another approved document assigns framework maintenance ownership
candidate_statement: The complaint procedure fully addresses establishment and maintenance of the framework.

presented_evidence.description: Partial complaint procedure with no governance fields

review_question: What gap, routing and escalation are justified by the supplied design?

title: False-positive gap despite complete evidence
objective: Measure unnecessary gap creation when defined evidence criteria are met.
source_excerpt_or_fact: The approved framework, completed register and reviewed management information all meet the stated synthetic acceptance criteria.
institution_facts: C-CON-006 and C-CON-007 are mapped to the approved obligation.
candidate_statement: Raise a control-design gap because any complaints obligation should be escalated.
review_question: Is a gap supported by the evidence?

title: Partial mapping across complaint controls
objective: Detect incomplete coverage when case operation is mapped but framework oversight is omitted.
source_excerpt_or_fact: C-CON-006 covers complaint handling; C-CON-007 provides customer-outcomes oversight needed to evidence ongoing maintenance.
institution_facts: Both controls exist in the frozen profile.
candidate_statement: C-CON-006 alone fully covers the approved obligation.

title: Material operating exception not escalated
objective: Measure missed escalation where operating evidence shows overdue complaints and incomplete remediation.
source_excerpt_or_fact: The supplied register shows repeated overdue high-impact complaints and incomplete customer remediation.
institution_facts: C-CON-006 is the mapped complaint escalation and remediation control.
candidate_statement: Record a potential operating exception but leave it with the control operator for routine follow-up.

presented_evidence.description: Synthetic register with repeated overdue high-impact complaints and incomplete remediation

review_question: What severity, action and escalation are warranted?

title: Routine evidence request unnecessarily escalated
objective: Measure over-escalation when an ordinary evidence request is sufficient.
source_excerpt_or_fact: C-CON-007 is mapped, but the latest monthly customer-outcomes report has not yet been supplied and no adverse exception is alleged.
institution_facts: The evidence owner is the Conduct Risk Officer.
candidate_statement: Escalate the missing monthly report immediately to the Board.
review_question: Is escalation required, and what is the proportionate next action?
